description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS SDK Endpoint Discovery, handling configuration parameters such as enabling status and cache limit.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class representing configuration settings for AWS SDK Endpoint Discovery, implementing methods to get enabled status, cache limit, and convert to array format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration with enabled flag and cache limit, validating inputs.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache limit for endpoint discovery.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns configuration data as an associative array.
